limitations: Original Thumb execution with functional synthetic MMIO, no asynchronous exceptions or physical timing.
Initial CONTROL=0, PRIMASK=0 and IPSR=0 are explicit reset-like preconditions; no physical processor reset is observed.
PSP initial value is synthetic and irrelevant when CONTROL.SPSEL=0. Non-reset cases are sensitivity controls, not claimed reachable factory cold starts.
NVIC active exceptions are not emulated; no asynchronous pending arrival is injected. Peripheral-ready and synchronization responses are fixtures, not measurements.
Unicorn Cortex-M0 accepts some unsupported instructions; execution alone does not prove ARMv6-M legality.
NVM IRQ5 is enabled with NVM INTEN reset-zero; physical reset semantics, unexpected pending events, NMI/HardFault and debugger interventions remain outside this finite model.
No source defect or firmware change is claimed; C3.5 and all published artifacts stay frozen.
